verses.original: Παῦλος δοῦλος Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ κλητὸς ἀπόστολος ἀφωρισμένος εἰς εὐαγγέλιον Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Paulos doulos Christou Iēsou klētos apostolos aphōrismenos eis euangelion Theou
verses.literal: Paul a servant of Christ Jesus called to be an apostle and set apart for the gospel of God
verses.literalPt: Paulo, servo de Cristo Jesus, chamado para ser apóstolo, separado para o Evangelho de Deus,

verses.original: ὃ προεπηγγείλατο διὰ τῶν προφητῶν αὐτοῦ ἐν γραφαῖς ἁγίαις
verses.transliteration: ho proepēngeilato dia tōn prophētōn autou en graphais hagiais
verses.literal: the gospel He promised beforehand through His prophets in the Holy Scriptures
verses.literalPt: que ele, antes, prometeu pelos seus profetas nas Santas Escrituras,

verses.original: περὶ τοῦ Υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ τοῦ γενομένου ἐκ σπέρματος Δαυὶδ κατὰ σάρκα
verses.transliteration: peri tou Huiou autou tou genomenou ek spermatos Dauid kata sarka
verses.literal: regarding His Son who was a descendant . . . . . . of David according to the flesh
verses.literalPt: acerca de seu Filho (que veio da descendência de Davi, quanto à carne,

verses.original: τοῦ ὁρισθέντος Υἱοῦ Θεοῦ ἐν δυνάμει κατὰ πνεῦμα ἁγιωσύνης ἐξ ἀναστάσεως νεκρῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: tou horisthentos Huiou Theou en dynamei kata pneuma hagiōsynēs ex anastaseōs nekrōn Iēsou Christou tou Kyriou hēmōn
verses.literal: and who through the Spirit of holiness was declared with power to be the Son of God by His resurrection from the dead Jesus Christ our Lord
verses.literalPt: e que foi com poder declarado Filho de Deus, quanto ao espírito de santidade, pela ressurreição dos mortos), Jesus Cristo, nosso Senhor,

verses.original: δι’ οὗ ἐλάβομεν χάριν καὶ ἀποστολὴν εἰς ὑπακοὴν πίστεως ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ὑπὲρ τοῦ ὀνόματος αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: di’ hou elabomen charin kai apostolēn eis hypakoēn pisteōs en pasin tois ethnesin hyper tou onomatos autou
verses.literal: Through Him and on behalf of His name we received grace and apostleship to call all those among the Gentiles to the obedience that comes from faith
verses.literalPt: pelo qual recebemos a graça e o apostolado por amor do seu nome, para obediência da fé em todas as nações,

verses.original: ἐν οἷς ἐστε καὶ ὑμεῖς κλητοὶ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: en hois este kai hymeis klētoi Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: And you also are among those who are called to belong to Jesus Christ
verses.literalPt: entre as quais sois também vós chamados para pertencerdes a Jesus Cristo.

verses.original: Πᾶσιν τοῖς οὖσιν ἐν Ῥώμῃ ἀγαπητοῖς Θεοῦ κλητοῖς ἁγίοις Χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ Θεοῦ Πατρὸς ἡμῶν καὶ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: Pasin tois ousin en Rhōmē agapētois Theou klētois hagiois Charis hymin kai eirēnē apo Theou Patros hēmōn kai Kyriou Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: To all - in Rome who are loved by God and called to be saints Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ
verses.literalPt: A todos os que estão em Roma, queridos de Deus, chamados para serem santos, graça a vós e paz da parte de Deus, nosso Pai, e da do Senhor Jesus Cristo.

verses.original: Πρῶτον μὲν εὐχαριστῶ τῷ Θεῷ μου διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ περὶ πάντων ὑμῶν ὅτι ἡ πίστις ὑμῶν καταγγέλλεται ἐν ὅλῳ τῷ κόσμῳ
verses.transliteration: Prōton men eucharistō tō Theō mou dia Iēsou Christou peri pantōn hymōn hoti hē pistis hymōn katangelletai en holō tō kosmō
verses.literal: First I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you because your faith is being proclaimed all over the world
verses.literalPt: Primeiramente, dou graças ao meu Deus, mediante Jesus Cristo, por todos vós, porque em todo o mundo é divulgada a vossa fé.

verses.original: μάρτυς γάρ μού ἐστιν ὁ Θεός ᾧ λατρεύω ἐν τῷ πνεύματί μου ἐν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ τοῦ Υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ ὡς ἀδιαλείπτως μνείαν ὑμῶν ποιοῦμαι
verses.transliteration: martys gar mou estin ho Theos hō latreuō en tō pneumati mou en tō euangeliō tou Huiou autou hōs adialeiptōs mneian hymōn poioumai
verses.literal: God whom I serve with my spirit in preaching the gospel of His Son is my witness how constantly I remember you
verses.literalPt: Pois Deus, a quem sirvo em meu espírito, no evangelho de seu Filho, é minha testemunha de como incessantemente faço menção de vós em todas as minhas orações,

verses.original: πάντοτε ἐπὶ τῶν προσευχῶν μου δεόμενος εἴ πως ἤδη ποτὲ εὐοδωθήσομαι ἐν τῷ θελήματι τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐλθεῖν πρὸς ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: pantote epi tōn proseuchōn mou deomenos ei pōs ēdē pote euodōthēsomai en tō thelēmati tou Theou elthein pros hymas
verses.literal: in my prayers at all times asking that . . . now at last by - God’s will I may succeed in coming to you
verses.literalPt: suplicando que se me abra afinal de qualquer modo um caminho favorável, sendo esta a vontade de Deus, para ir ter convosco.

verses.original: ἐπιποθῶ γὰρ ἰδεῖν ὑμᾶς ἵνα τι μεταδῶ χάρισμα ὑμῖν πνευματικὸν εἰς τὸ στηριχθῆναι ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: epipothō gar idein hymas hina ti metadō charisma hymin pneumatikon eis to stērichthēnai hymas
verses.literal: For I long to see you so that I may impart to you some spiritual gift to strengthen you
verses.literalPt: Pois tenho grande desejo de ver-vos, para vos comunicar algum dom espiritual, a fim de que sejais firmados,

verses.original: τοῦτο δέ ἐστιν συμπαρακληθῆναι ἐν ὑμῖν διὰ τῆς ἐν ἀλλήλοις πίστεως ὑμῶν τε καὶ ἐμοῦ
verses.transliteration: touto de estin symparaklēthēnai en hymin dia tēs en allēlois pisteōs hymōn te kai emou
verses.literal: that is that you and I may be mutually encouraged . . . . . . by each other’s faith
verses.literalPt: isto é, para que em vós seja eu consolado juntamente convosco pela fé, vossa e minha, que há em nós.

verses.original: Οὐ θέλω δὲ ὑμᾶς ἀγνοεῖν ἀδελφοί ὅτι πολλάκις προεθέμην ἐλθεῖν πρὸς ὑμᾶς καὶ ἐκωλύθην ἄχρι τοῦ δεῦρο ἵνα τινὰ καρπὸν σχῶ καὶ ἐν ὑμῖν καθὼς καὶ ἐν τοῖς λοιποῖς ἔθνεσιν
verses.transliteration: Ou thelō de hymas agnoein adelphoi hoti pollakis proethemēn elthein pros hymas kai ekōlythēn achri tou deuro hina tina karpon schō kai en hymin kathōs kai en tois loipois ethnesin
verses.literal: I do not want you to be unaware brothers how often I planned to come to you (but have been prevented from visiting until now) in order that I might have a harvest among you just as I have had among the other Gentiles
verses.literalPt: Não quero que ignoreis, irmãos, que muitas vezes tenho proposto ir ver-vos (mas tenho sido impedido até agora), para conseguir algum fruto entre vós também, como entre os demais gentios.

verses.original: Ἕλλησίν τε καὶ Βαρβάροις σοφοῖς τε καὶ ἀνοήτοις ὀφειλέτης εἰμί
verses.transliteration: Hellēsin te kai Barbarois sophois te kai anoētois opheiletēs eimi
verses.literal: I am obligated both to Greeks and non-Greeks both to the wise and the foolish
verses.literalPt: Eu sou devedor a gregos e a bárbaros, a sábios e a ignorantes;

verses.original: οὕτως τὸ κατ’ ἐμὲ πρόθυμον καὶ ὑμῖν τοῖς ἐν Ῥώμῃ εὐαγγελίσασθαι
verses.transliteration: houtōs to kat’ eme prothymon kai hymin tois en Rhōmē euangelisasthai
verses.literal: That is why - I am so eager to preach the gospel also to you who are in Rome
verses.literalPt: assim, quanto é em mim, estou pronto para anunciar o evangelho também a vós que estais em Roma.

verses.original: Οὐ γὰρ ἐπαισχύνομαι τὸ εὐαγγέλιον δύναμις γὰρ Θεοῦ ἐστιν εἰς σωτηρίαν παντὶ τῷ πιστεύοντι Ἰουδαίῳ τε πρῶτον καὶ Ἕλληνι
verses.transliteration: Ou gar epaischynomai to euangelion dynamis gar Theou estin eis sōtērian panti tō pisteuonti Ioudaiō te prōton kai Hellēni
verses.literal: I am not ashamed of the gospel because it is the power of God for salvation to everyone who believes first to the Jew then to the Greek
verses.literalPt: Pois não me envergonho do evangelho, porque ele é poder de Deus para a salvação de todo aquele que crê, primeiro do judeu e depois do grego.

verses.original: δικαιοσύνη γὰρ Θεοῦ ἐν αὐτῷ ἀποκαλύπτεται ἐκ πίστεως εἰς πίστιν καθὼς γέγραπται Ὁ δὲ δίκαιος ἐκ πίστεως ζήσεται
verses.transliteration: dikaiosynē gar Theou en autō apokalyptetai ek pisteōs eis pistin kathōs gegraptai Ho de dikaios ek pisteōs zēsetai
verses.literal: For the gospel reveals the righteousness of God that comes by faith from start to finish just as it is written The righteous will live by faith
verses.literalPt: Pois no evangelho é revelada, de fé em fé, a justiça de Deus, como está escrito: Mas o justo viverá da fé.

verses.original: Ἀποκαλύπτεται γὰρ ὀργὴ Θεοῦ ἀπ’ οὐρανοῦ ἐπὶ πᾶσαν ἀσέβειαν καὶ ἀδικίαν ἀνθρώπων τῶν τὴν ἀλήθειαν ἐν ἀδικίᾳ κατεχόντων
verses.transliteration: Apokalyptetai gar orgē Theou ap’ ouranou epi pasan asebeian kai adikian anthrōpōn tōn tēn alētheian en adikia katechontōn
verses.literal: The wrath of God is being revealed from heaven against all the godlessness and wickedness of men who suppress the truth by their wickedness
verses.literalPt: A ira de Deus é revelada do céu contra toda a impiedade e injustiça daqueles que retêm a verdade em injustiça;

verses.original: διότι τὸ γνωστὸν τοῦ Θεοῦ φανερόν ἐστιν ἐν αὐτοῖς ὁ θεὸς γὰρ αὐτοῖς ἐφανέρωσεν
verses.transliteration: dioti to gnōston tou Theou phaneron estin en autois ho theos gar autois ephanerōsen
verses.literal: For what may be known about God is plain to them because God has made it plain to them
verses.literalPt: porquanto o que se pode conhecer de Deus neles está manifesto; pois Deus lho manifestou.

verses.original: τὰ γὰρ ἀόρατα αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ κτίσεως κόσμου τοῖς ποιήμασιν νοούμενα καθορᾶται ἥ τε ἀΐδιος αὐτοῦ δύναμις καὶ θειότης εἰς τὸ εἶναι αὐτοὺς ἀναπολογήτους
verses.transliteration: ta gar aorata autou apo ktiseōs kosmou tois poiēmasin nooumena kathoratai hē te aidios autou dynamis kai theiotēs eis to einai autous anapologētous
verses.literal: For since the creation of the world God’s invisible qualities - His eternal power and divine nature have been clearly seen being understood from His workmanship so that men are without excuse
verses.literalPt: As perfeições invisíveis dele, o seu poder eterno e a sua divindade, claramente se veem desde a criação do mundo, sendo percebidas pelas suas obras, para que eles sejam inescusáveis;

verses.original: Διότι γνόντες τὸν Θεὸν οὐχ ὡς Θεὸν ἐδόξασαν ἢ ηὐχαρίστησαν ἀλλὰ ἐματαιώθησαν ἐν τοῖς διαλογισμοῖς αὐτῶν καὶ ἐσκοτίσθη ἡ ἀσύνετος αὐτῶν καρδία
verses.transliteration: Dioti gnontes ton Theon ouch hōs Theon edoxasan ē ēucharistēsan alla emataiōthēsan en tois dialogismois autōn kai eskotisthē hē asynetos autōn kardia
verses.literal: For although they knew God they neither glorified Him . . . as God nor gave thanks to Him but they became futile in their thinking and darkened in their foolish hearts
verses.literalPt: porquanto, conhecendo a Deus, não o glorificaram como a Deus, nem deram graças; antes, se enfatuaram nas suas especulações, e ficou em trevas o seu coração insensato.

verses.original: φάσκοντες εἶναι σοφοὶ ἐμωράνθησαν
verses.transliteration: phaskontes einai sophoi emōranthēsan
verses.literal: Although they claimed to be wise they became fools
verses.literalPt: Dizendo-se sábios, tornaram-se estultos

verses.original: καὶ ἤλλαξαν τὴν δόξαν τοῦ ἀφθάρτου Θεοῦ ἐν ὁμοιώματι εἰκόνος φθαρτοῦ ἀνθρώπου καὶ πετεινῶν καὶ τετραπόδων καὶ ἑρπετῶν
verses.transliteration: kai ēllaxan tēn doxan tou aphthartou Theou en homoiōmati eikonos phthartou anthrōpou kai peteinōn kai tetrapodōn kai herpetōn
verses.literal: and exchanged the glory of the immortal God for images of mortal man and birds and animals and reptiles
verses.literalPt: e deixaram a glória do Deus incorruptível por uma semelhança de figura de homem corruptível, de aves, quadrúpedes e de répteis.

verses.original: Διὸ παρέδωκεν αὐτοὺς ὁ Θεὸς ἐν ταῖς ἐπιθυμίαις τῶν καρδιῶν αὐτῶν εἰς ἀκαθαρσίαν τοῦ ἀτιμάζεσθαι τὰ σώματα αὐτῶν ἐν αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: Dio paredōken autous ho Theos en tais epithymiais tōn kardiōn autōn eis akatharsian tou atimazesthai ta sōmata autōn en autois
verses.literal: Therefore God gave them over . . . in the desires of their hearts to impurity for the dishonoring of their bodies with one another
verses.literalPt: Por isso, os entregou Deus, nos desejos impuros dos seus corações, à imundícia, a fim de serem os seus corpos desonrados entre si;

verses.original: οἵτινες μετήλλαξαν τὴν ἀλήθειαν τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐν τῷ ψεύδει καὶ ἐσεβάσθησαν καὶ ἐλάτρευσαν τῇ κτίσει παρὰ τὸν Κτίσαντα ὅς ἐστιν εὐλογητὸς εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας ἀμήν
verses.transliteration: hoitines metēllaxan tēn alētheian tou Theou en tō pseudei kai esebasthēsan kai elatreusan tē ktisei para ton Ktisanta hos estin eulogētos eis tous aiōnas amēn
verses.literal: They exchanged the truth of God for a lie and worshiped and served the creature rather than the Creator who is forever worthy of praise Amen
verses.literalPt: os quais trocaram a verdade de Deus pela mentira, e adoraram, e serviram a criatura antes que o Criador, que é bendito para sempre. Amém.

verses.original: Διὰ τοῦτο παρέδωκεν αὐτοὺς ὁ Θεὸς εἰς πάθη ἀτιμίας αἵ τε γὰρ θήλειαι αὐτῶν μετήλλαξαν τὴν φυσικὴν χρῆσιν εἰς τὴν παρὰ φύσιν
verses.transliteration: Dia touto paredōken autous ho Theos eis pathē atimias hai te gar thēleiai autōn metēllaxan tēn physikēn chrēsin eis tēn para physin
verses.literal: For this reason . . . God gave them over . . . to dishonorable passions Even their women exchanged natural relations for unnatural ones
verses.literalPt: Por isso os entregou Deus a paixões vis; pois as suas mulheres mudaram o uso natural pelo que é contra a natureza.

verses.original: ὁμοίως τε καὶ οἱ ἄρσενες ἀφέντες τὴν φυσικὴν χρῆσιν τῆς θηλείας ἐξεκαύθησαν ἐν τῇ ὀρέξει αὐτῶν εἰς ἀλλήλους ἄρσενες ἐν ἄρσεσιν τὴν ἀσχημοσύνην κατεργαζόμενοι καὶ τὴν ἀντιμισθίαν ἣν ἔδει τῆς πλάνης αὐτῶν ἐν ἑαυτοῖς ἀπολαμβάνοντες
verses.transliteration: homoiōs te kai hoi arsenes aphentes tēn physikēn chrēsin tēs thēleias exekauthēsan en tē orexei autōn eis allēlous arsenes en arsesin tēn aschēmosynēn katergazomenoi kai tēn antimisthian hēn edei tēs planēs autōn en heautois apolambanontes
verses.literal: Likewise the men abandoned natural relations with women and burned with - lust for one another Men committed indecent acts with other men and received in themselves the due penalty for their error
verses.literalPt: Do mesmo modo, também os homens, deixando o uso natural da mulher, inflamaram-se em sua concupiscência uns para com os outros, cometendo homens com homens a torpeza e recebendo em si mesmos a devida recompensa do seu desvario.

verses.original: Καὶ καθὼς οὐκ ἐδοκίμασαν τὸν Θεὸν ἔχειν ἐν ἐπιγνώσει παρέδωκεν αὐτοὺς ὁ Θεὸς εἰς ἀδόκιμον νοῦν ποιεῖν τὰ μὴ καθήκοντα
verses.transliteration: Kai kathōs ouk edokimasan ton Theon echein en epignōsei paredōken autous ho Theos eis adokimon noun poiein ta mē kathēkonta
verses.literal: Furthermore since they did not see fit to acknowledge . . . . . . God He gave them up . . . to a depraved mind to do what ought not to be done
verses.literalPt: Assim como eles rejeitaram a Deus, tendo dele pleno conhecimento, ele os entregou a um sentimento reprovado, para fazerem essas coisas que não convêm,

verses.original: πεπληρωμένους πάσῃ ἀδικίᾳ πονηρίᾳ πλεονεξίᾳ κακίᾳ μεστοὺς φθόνου φόνου ἔριδος δόλου κακοηθείας ψιθυριστάς
verses.transliteration: peplērōmenous pasē adikia ponēria pleonexia kakia mestous phthonou phonou eridos dolou kakoētheias psithyristas
verses.literal: They have become filled with every kind of wickedness evil greed and depravity They are full of envy murder strife deceit and malice They are gossips
verses.literalPt: cheios de toda injustiça, malícia, avareza e maldade; cheios de inveja, homicídio, contenda, dolo e malignidade; detratores,

verses.original: καταλάλους θεοστυγεῖς ὑβριστάς ὑπερηφάνους ἀλαζόνας ἐφευρετὰς κακῶν γονεῦσιν ἀπειθεῖς
verses.transliteration: katalalous theostygeis hybristas hyperēphanous alazonas epheuretas kakōn goneusin apeitheis
verses.literal: slanderers God-haters insolent arrogant and boastful They invent new forms of evil they disobey their parents
verses.literalPt: difamadores, aborrecíveis a Deus, insolentes, soberbos, presunçosos, inventores de males, desobedientes aos pais,

verses.original: ἀσυνέτους ἀσυνθέτους ἀστόργους ἀνελεήμονας
verses.transliteration: asynetous asynthetous astorgous aneleēmonas
verses.literal: They are senseless faithless heartless merciless
verses.literalPt: insensatos, pérfidos, sem afeição natural e sem misericórdia.

verses.original: οἵτινες τὸ δικαίωμα τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐπιγνόντες ὅτι οἱ τὰ τοιαῦτα πράσσοντες ἄξιοι θανάτου εἰσίν οὐ μόνον αὐτὰ ποιοῦσιν ἀλλὰ καὶ συνευδοκοῦσιν τοῖς πράσσουσιν
verses.transliteration: hoitines to dikaiōma tou Theou epignontes hoti hoi ta toiauta prassontes axioi thanatou eisin ou monon auta poiousin alla kai syneudokousin tois prassousin
verses.literal: Although they know - God’s righteous decree that those who do such things are worthy of death they not only continue to do these things but also approve of those who practice them
verses.literalPt: Eles, conhecendo bem o decreto de Deus, que são dignos de morte os que tais coisas praticam, não somente as fazem, mas também consentem aos que as praticam.
